findings.statement: Kenya's inflation rose by 1.1 percentage points from 2015 to 2023, a linear trend of 0.085 percentage points per year.

findings.statement: Nigeria's inflation trended up by 1.24 percentage points per year over 2015 to 2023.

findings.statement: Shared regional price pressures may explain why both rose; the data shows association, not cause.
